title: 第2610章 准备对拓跋家族出手第2609章 大不了一战
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
梦青璃看着屠天行，俏脸冰冷，眼中满是愤怒之色。
“屠天行，我已经离开七杀星域，你为何还要赶尽杀绝？”
屠天行背负双手，神情冷漠地看着她。
“赶尽杀绝？”
“梦青璃，你以为本星主大老远来到幽冥星域，真是为了杀你？”
梦青璃眉头一皱。
屠天行冷声道：“只要你交出噬天镜，本星主可以饶你一命。”
“噬天镜？”
听到这三个字，楚云目光一凝。
站在他身边的金云霄，以及天域宫带来的修士，同样露出吃惊之色。
显然，他们也听说过噬天镜。
传闻噬天镜乃是一件上古至宝，不但能够吞噬星力，还能映照天地，找出隐藏在虚空中的宝物和修士。
更重要的是，噬天镜里面似乎还隐藏着一处上古遗迹。
只不过此物已经消失数万年，很多人都以为只是传说。
没想到，屠天行居然会为了此物，亲自追杀梦青璃来到幽冥星域。
梦青璃脸色阴沉，冷声道：“什么噬天镜，我根本没有。”
屠天行眼中露出浓郁杀机。
“梦青璃，事到如今，你还想骗本星主？”
“当年你在七杀星域北荒禁地历练，除了你之外，进入其中的人全部死了。”
“后来有人看见你从禁地深处出来，手中还拿着一面黑色古镜。”

“不是噬天镜，又是什么？”
梦青璃冷声道：“当年我确实在北荒禁地得到过一面古镜。”
“但那面古镜早就在我逃离七杀星域时遗失了。”
“你就算杀了我，也别想得到噬天镜。”
屠天行目光冰冷，道：“既然你不给，那就别怪本星主心狠手辣。”
轰！
随着这话响起，一股更加恐怖的星力，从屠天行身上爆发出来。
周围虚空剧烈震动。
只见屠天行抬起手掌，掌心之中星光汇聚，瞬间凝聚成一只数十丈大的黑色巨掌。
巨掌还没有落下，姬家堡上空便出现大量裂纹。
城墙上的姬家修士，顿时吓得脸色苍白。
楚云见状，连忙朝着金云霄大声喊道：“金长老，我们神龙殿可是购买了庇护令。”
content_en:
Meng Qingli looked at Tu Tianxing, her pretty face was cold and her eyes were full of anger.
"Tu Tianxing, I have left the Seven Kills Star Territory, why do you still want to kill them all?"
Tu Tianxing put his hands behind his back and looked at her indifferently.
"Kill them all?"
"Meng Qingli, do you think this star master came all the way to the Netherworld Star Territory just to kill you?"
Meng Qingli frowned.
Tu Tianxing said coldly: "As long as you hand over the Sky-Eating Mirror, this Star Master will spare your life."
"Sky-Eating Mirror?"
Upon hearing these three words, Chu Yun's eyes narrowed.
Jin Yunxiao, who was standing next to him, and the monks brought by Tianyu Palace also looked surprised.
Obviously, they had also heard of the Sky-Eating Mirror.
It is rumored that the Sky-Eating Mirror is an ancient treasure that can not only swallow star power, but also reflect the heaven and earth to find treasures and monks hidden in the void.
More importantly, there seems to be an ancient ruin hidden inside the Sky-Eating Mirror.
But this thing has disappeared for tens of thousands of years, and many people think it is just a legend.
Unexpectedly, Tu Tianxing would personally hunt down Meng Qingli and come to the Netherworld Star Territory for this object.
Meng Qingli's face was gloomy and she said coldly: "What kind of sky-eating mirror? I don't have one at all."
Tu Tianxing's eyes showed strong murderous intent.
"Meng Qingli, now that things have happened, you still want to deceive this star master?"
"Back then, when you were training in the Northern Wilderness Forbidden Area of the Seven Kills Star Territory, everyone who entered it died except you."
"Later, someone saw you coming out of the depths of the forbidden area, holding an ancient black mirror in your hand."
"If it's not the Sky-Eating Mirror, then what is it?"
Meng Qingli said coldly: "I did get an ancient mirror in the Northern Wasteland."
"But that ancient mirror was lost long ago when I escaped from the Seven Kills Star Territory."
"Even if you kill me, you still can't get the Sky-Eating Mirror."
Tu Tianxing's eyes were cold and he said: "Since you won't give it, don't blame this star master for being cruel."
Boom!
As these words rang out, an even more terrifying star power burst out from Tu Tianxing.
The surrounding void shook violently.
Tu Tianxing raised his palm, and the stars in his palm gathered together, instantly condensing into a giant black palm dozens of feet long.
Before the giant palm fell, a large number of cracks appeared in the sky above Jijiabao.
The Ji family monks on the city wall suddenly turned pale with fear.
Seeing this, Chu Yun quickly shouted to Jin Yunxiao: "Elder Jin, our Shenlong Temple has purchased a shelter order."
